gripOrHq.title: Vewy Vewy Quiet
gripOrHq.rulesText: Put [2] from the bank on Vewy Vewy Quiet when it is installed. Use these bits only to pay for using icebreakers during runs, but not for using noisy icebreakers. If you use any of these bits, replace them at the start of your next turn.

gripOrHq.title: Corolla Speed Chip
gripOrHq.rulesText: Put [1] from the bank on Corolla Speed Chip when it is installed. Use this bit only to pay for using killers during runs. If you use the bit, replace it from the bank at the start of your next turn.

heapOrArchives.title: Short-Term Contract
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Put [12] from the bank on Short-Term Contract when it is installed. When all the bits have been removed, trash Short-Term Contract. A: Take [2] from Short-Term Contract.

heapOrArchives.title: Temple Microcode Outlet
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Search your stack for a program. Show that program to the Corp, and then bring it into your hand. Shuffle your stack afterwards.

scoreArea.title: Strike Force Kali
scoreArea.rulesText: A: Do 2 meat damage. Use this ability only if Runner is tagged.

rig.title: R&D Interface
rig.rulesText: Whenever you access cards from R&D, access an additional card from R&D.

ice.title: Jack Attack
ice.rulesText:
[Subroutine] For the remainder of the run, Runner cannot jack out.
[Subroutine] Trace 5 - If trace is successful, give Runner a tag.

ice.title: Hunter
ice.rulesText: [Subroutine] Trace 5 - If trace is successful, give Runner a tag.

root.title: Turbeau Delacroix
root.rulesText: Trace 10-If trace is successful, give Runner a tag. Use this ability only when Runner accesses Turbeau Delacroix, and only once during each run on this fort.

root.title: Chance Observation
root.rulesText: Play only if Runner attempted a run during last turn. Trace 5 - If successful, give Runner 1 tag.

root.title: Punitive Counterstrike
root.rulesText: Play only if Runner is tagged. Do 2 meat damage.

encounteredIce.title: Jack Attack
encounteredIce.rulesText:
[Subroutine] For the remainder of the run, Runner cannot jack out.
[Subroutine] Trace 5 - If trace is successful, give Runner a tag.
